questions.question: A financier claims to be lending money at simple interest, but he includes the interest every six months for calculating the principal. If he is charging an interest of 20% p.a., the effective rate of interest becomes:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Nominal interest rate = 20% p.a.

Interest added every 6 months (i.e., semi-annually)

**Formula Used:**

Effective Rate = (1 + r/2)² − 1

where r = annual rate

**Calculation:**

⇒ Semi-annual rate = 20% ÷ 2

⇒ Semi-annual rate = 10% = 0.10

⇒ Effective rate = (1 + 0.10)² − 1

⇒ Effective rate = (1.10)² − 1

⇒ Effective rate = 1.21 − 1

⇒ Effective rate = 0.21

⇒ Effective rate = 21%

**∴ The effective rate of interest becomes 21%.**

questions.question: A sum of ₹12,000 amounts to ₹20,736 in 3 years at certain rate per cent per annum interest compounded annually. What will be the amount (in ₹) of the same sum in 4 years at the same rate on compound interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = 12,000

Amount after 3 years = 20,736

Rate = r% compounded annually

**Formula Used:**

Amount = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

Find (1 + r/100) using 3-year amount

Then compute amount for 4 years

**Calculation:**

⇒ 20,736 = 12,000(1 + r/100)³

⇒ (1 + r/100)³ = 20,736 ÷ 12,000

⇒ (1 + r/100)³ = 1.728

⇒ 1 + r/100 = ³√1.728

⇒ 1 + r/100 = 1.2

⇒ r/100 = 0.2

⇒ r = 20%

**Now amount for 4 years:**

Amount₄ = 12,000(1.2)⁴

⇒ (1.2)⁴ = 2.0736

⇒ Amount₄ = 12,000 × 2.0736

⇒ Amount₄ = 24,883.2

**∴ The amount after 4 years is ₹24,883.20.**

questions.question: A metallic wire is bent to form a square of area 324 { m}² . If the same wire is bent to form a semicircle (closed figure), then the radius (in m) of the semicircle is ________. {(Take } pi = (22)/(7) {)}
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of square = 324 m²

Same wire forms a semicircle (closed figure)

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Side of square = √Area

Perimeter of square = wire length

Semicircle closed length = curved length + diameter = πr + 2r

**Calculation:**

⇒ Side of square = √324 = 18 m

⇒ Perimeter of square = 4 × 18 = 72 m

⇒ Wire length = 72 m

⇒ For semicircle: πr + 2r = 72

⇒ r(π + 2) = 72

⇒ r = 72 ÷ (22/7 + 2)

⇒ r = 72 ÷ (22/7 + 14/7)

⇒ r = 72 ÷ (36/7)

⇒ r = 72 × 7/36

⇒ r = 14

**∴ The radius of the semicircle is 14 m.**

questions.question: Kunal was asked to find (5)/(6) times a number. He multiplies it by(6)/(5) As a result, he got an answer which was more than the correct answer by 561.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Kunal was supposed to find (5/6) of a number.

He mistakenly multiplied the number by (6/5).

His wrong answer is 561 more than the correct answer.

Let the number = x.

**Formula Used:**

Correct answer = (5/6)x

Wrong answer = (6/5)x

Difference = Wrong − Correct

**Calculation:**

⇒ (6/5)x − (5/6)x = 561

⇒ (36/30 − 25/30)x = 561

⇒ (11/30)x = 561

⇒ x = 561 × (30/11)

⇒ x = 51 × 30

⇒ x = 1530

**∴ The number is 1530.**

questions.question: If a nine-digit number 785x3678y is divisible by 72, then the value of (3x-4y) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Nine-digit number = 785x3678y

Number is divisible by 72 ⇒ divisible by 8 and 9

**Formula Used:**

For divisibility by 8 → Last 3 digits divisible by 8

For divisibility by 9 → Sum of digits divisible by 9

**Calculation:**

**Divisibility by 8**

Last three digits = 7 8 y = 78y

⇒ 78y must be divisible by 8

Checking y = 0 to 9:

⇒ 784 is divisible by 8 ⇒ y = 4

**Divisibility by 9**

Sum of digits = 7 + 8 + 5 + x + 3 + 6 + 7 + 8 + 4

⇒ Sum = 48 + x

For divisibility by 9:

48 + x ≡ 0 (mod 9)

48 mod 9 = 3

⇒ 3 + x ≡ 0 (mod 9)

⇒ x ≡ 6 (mod 9)

⇒ x = 6

**Find (3x − 4y)**

⇒ 3x − 4y = 3(6) − 4(4)

⇒ 18 − 16 = 2

**∴ The value of (3x − 4y) is 2.**

questions.question: Which largest number will divide 2,042 and 233 leaving remainders 18 and 13, respectively?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number leaving remainder 18 when dividing 2042

Number leaving remainder 13 when dividing 233

**Formula Used:**

If a number leaves remainders r₁ and r₂, then it divides:

(N₁ − r₁) and (N₂ − r₂)

Required number = HCF(N₁ − r₁, N₂ − r₂)

**Calculation:**

⇒ 2042 − 18 = 2024

⇒ 233 − 13 = 220

⇒ Required number = HCF(2024, 220)

⇒ 2024 ÷ 220 = 9 remainder 44

⇒ 220 ÷ 44 = 0 remainder 0

⇒ HCF = 44

**∴ The required largest number is 44.**

questions.question: A can do a certain job in 18 days. B is 50% more efficient than A. How many days does B alone take to do the same job?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can do the job in 18 days

B is 50% more efficient than A

**Formula Used:**

If efficiency increases by k%, time becomes 100/(100+k)% of original time

Time = Work ÷ Efficiency

**Calculation:**

⇒ A's efficiency = 1 unit

⇒ B's efficiency = 1 + 50% of 1 = 1.5 units

⇒ Time taken by B = A's time ÷ 1.5

⇒ Time taken by B = 18 ÷ 1.5

⇒ Time taken by B = 12 days

**∴ B alone can do the job in 12 days.**
